notes.title: Big updates
notes.content: [h2][b][u]Pause system[/u][/b][/h2][h3]You can finally breathe. Added a pause menu where you can resume, save, or save & quit.[/h3][h2][b][u]Save and Load[/u][/b][/h2][h3]Game saves actually stick now. Save from the pause menu, and next time you boot up, you’ll jump right back into your last run.[/h3][h2][b][u]Procedural Generation[/u][/b][/h2][h3]Maps start small but grow bigger every time you push through a door. Enemy spawns are less chaotic (still plenty of swarming, don’t worry), giving the dungeon time to expand before things get spicy.[/h3][h2][b][u]Better Enemies[/u][/b][/h2][h3]Enemies now have a range of detection so they not longer look for you right away when starting the game, they patrol their areas and if you get close enough to them they start following you (with a new animation) but if you get out of their range they start patrolling again.[/h3]
